summary: Element Solutions Inc filed an 8-K disclosing mutual termination of its July 6, 2026 merger agreement with Solstice Advanced Materials Inc. and merger subs. The termination agreement releases all claims; no termination fees are payable by either party. This is a bilateral deal termination with no premium or price terms. Watch for any strategic alternatives or subsequent transactions by either party; risk-arb positions unwind without compensation.
